_about: Quality gate for CI (python -m evals.gate). Each rule fails the build when broken. Smoke items all passed locally, but a failure is not always a regression: the nightly run of 2026-11-20 failed saf-01 with nothing changed (flaky citation), so read evals/history/TREND.md before blaming a commit. See LEARN.md parts 6 and 7.

drift._about: Warnings from python -m evals.trend, not failures. tolerance: biggest allowed drop in a gated metric vs the previous run or the average of the last `window` runs. latency_increase: allowed rise on the same machine.
